text.에이전트 구조도 프로필을 보고 검사한다: Lists and checks agent architecture map profiles
Architecture map projection limits (server administrator values).
text.이벤트를 본문으로 넘겨 그리는 요청(POST /architecture/p: Maximum number of events a request that sends events in the body to draw a map (POST /architecture/project) accepts. Above this, the map isn't drawn and a scope-too-large error is returned.
Raise this when another tool needs to send a large batch of events to draw an architecture map.
text.로그 범위(세션·실행)를 구조도로 그릴 때 셀 최대 이벤트 수. 로그 연: Maximum number of events counted when drawing a log scope (session or run) as an architecture map. The logs integration reads this value. Above this, the map isn't drawn and you're asked to narrow the filter.
Raise this when the architecture map of a very long session doesn't show because it exceeds the limit.

codes.architecture.settings_invalid: Part of the architecture map settings is invalid, so that part is ignored ({errors} problems).
